text:
maria: Kicking off deployment v1.3.4 to eu-west — staggered roll (5% -> 50%). Preflight SLO smoke running.

deploy-bot: deploy started: service=embed-router, version=v1.3.4, stage=canary, shift=5%

release-bot: changelog: https://git.redwood/release/v1.3.4 :page_facing_up:

sam: @maria seeing embed-p95 spike on the canary slice 110ms -> 260ms, and a small 502 uptick :eyes:

liz: confirming, 502 rate jumped ~0.9% -> 4.2% on /v1/embeds. quick log sample:```
2026-03-22T12:01:45Z embed-router[canary] ERROR 502 GET /v1/embeds 0.17s
2026-03-22T12:01:46Z embed-router[canary] ERROR 502 POST /v1/embeds 0.22s
```

maria: pausing traffic shift at 5% and applying a version pin for eu-west. can someone confirm pin applied and stop the ramp? :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: traffic shift paused. version_pin applied: region=eu-west pinned_to=v1.3.3

sam: dashboards show p95 starting to move down slightly but 502s still elevated. holding for 8m to observe trend.

liz: initial hypothesis: kv-cache cold-path regression in the new handler. tagging runtime. @tim can you check traces for kvcache misses?
tim: pulling traces now — I see a spike in kvcache miss rate and an extra downstream call per request on v1.3.4. reproducing locally on canary build.

maria: decision: hold and do not ramp. if errors don't return to baseline within 10m we'll roll back to v1.3.2 and open a rollback incident. updating release notes accordingly.
sam: noted — updating the deploy watch doc and alerting CS to expect potential rollback. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: incident created: INCIDENT-20260322-EMBED-CANARY-502 (severity=high, owner=@sam)

release-bot: rollback runbook PR opened: https://git.redwood/release/rollbacks/12345 — includes steps to revert canary and reconcile traffic pins.

liz: 2m in and errors are already down ~30% from peak. I'll keep monitoring for another 6m before we decide.
maria: thanks everyone. hold remains. will post final decision at end of watch window.

maria: standing by for updates, all hands ready if we need a rollback.
